# aikido_custom_sast_rules (Data Source)

Lists every custom SAST rule in the workspace, whether created in Terraform or in the Aikido dashboard. Use it to find the ID of a rule to import into aikido_custom_sast_rule, or to check which rules failed during a scan. The API client needs the custom_sast_rules:read scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aikido_custom_sast_rules" "all" {}

# IDs to import rules created in the Aikido dashboard into aikido_custom_sast_rule.
output "custom_rule_ids_by_title" {
  value = { for rule in data.aikido_custom_sast_rules.all.rules : rule.issue_title => rule.id }
}

# Rules that failed during a scan find nothing until they are fixed.
output "failing_custom_rules" {
  value = [for rule in data.aikido_custom_sast_rules.all.rules : rule.issue_title if rule.has_error]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) Custom rules, ordered by Aikido custom rule ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `has_error` (Boolean) Whether an Aikido scan failed on this rule since it was last saved.
- `how_to_fix` (String) Instructions for fixing the issue.
- `id` (String) Aikido custom rule ID, as a string to match the id attribute of aikido_custom_sast_rule.
- `issue_title` (String) Title of the issues this rule raises.
- `language` (String) Language the rule targets.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the issues this rule raises, from 1 to 100.
- `semgrep_rule` (String) The semgrep rule as Aikido stores it, with its rule id replaced by CUSTOM-RULE-<id>.
- `tldr` (String) Short explanation of the issue.
